name: Del Amo Fashion Center
description: Del Amo Fashion Center is one of the largest shopping malls in the United States, spanning over 2.5 million square feet in the heart of Torrance. This premier shopping destination features over 200 stores including luxury retailers, department store anchors like Macy's and Nordstrom, diverse dining options, and entertainment venues. Recently renovated with modern amenities and open-air components, it serves as the South Bay's premier retail hub.
demographics: The mall serves the affluent South Bay Los Angeles area, including Torrance, Redondo Beach, Manhattan Beach, and surrounding communities with a diverse, upper-middle-class demographic.
summary: Del Amo Fashion Center is one of America's largest shopping destinations, offering over 200 stores across 2.5 million square feet of retail, dining, and entertainment in Torrance's South Bay area.
